About this opportunity: 
 The MS Core and Cloud Specialist Role is responsible for the coordination, management and execution of proactive and reactive maintenance activities that require a higher level expertise. This shall ensure that the services provided to customers are continuously available and performing to Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance levels.
 You will: 
 Ensure Technical Authority(2nd lvl) Support Activities
 Ensure Technical Authority(2nd lvl) Incident Management
 Ensure Preventive Maintenance and Performance Management
 Assist Problem Management
 Support in project activities
 Take part periodically to the Team’s 24x7 Oncall Rota.
 Skills you must bring:
 Min.5 years of hands-on experience in a large IP network ( switching, routing, security/ firewalls ), structured, enterprise environment: preferably Juniper or Cisco or Nokia ISP & Enterprise Routing/Switching/Security appliances
 You have to demonstrate very good understanding of IP Networking technologies/protocols, Solid troubleshooting/debugging skills are mandatory:
ISIS, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, L3VPN, NG-MVPN, Multicast
Cisco (CCNA, CCNP, CCNP SP);
Juniper (JNCIA, JNCIP-SP);
Huawei networking knowledge is a plus: NE, ATN
Nokia networking knowledge is a plus: 7750 SR
Understanding of Mobile Networks 2G/3G/4G/5G is a plus;
Linux knowledge is a plus
Scripting skill is a plus.
Knowledge of working in an ITIL controlled environment
Min.B2 level at English in both writing and speaking.
